description: Pairs of a new email and the one enquiry already on file, labelled duplicate or not, for precision and recall of the duplicate check (D36). Covers forwards, replies quoting the original, rewordings, translations, kilograms, a correction, new attachments, another tenant, other tonnage, thickness and delivery city, and the 14-day window.

changelog.change: First 14 pairs (llm-drafted, unverified): 8 resends (dup-008, a correction, is a known limitation) and 6 new orders.

Owner decisions: corrections are recognised (F-012), so dup-008 is no longer a known limitation; the 14-day window applies to exact copies (dup-015, two months later: new order); an enquiry that failed on our side does not count (dup-016: handled). Added German and Polish corrections (dup-017, dup-018).
